violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification
violation_type.typical_finding: While reviewing directors qualifications on the boad it was seen the Children's Product Certification had not been signed since January 2, 2022. This was corrected at the inspection when a new certification form was signed.

finding_variants.text: While reviewing directors qualifications on the boad it was seen the Children's Product Certification had not been signed since January 2, 2022. This was corrected at the inspection when a new certification form was signed.
The operation did not have an up to date and signed Children's Products Certification Form.
The operation did not have a current product safety certification.     The operation posted current product certification.
Form 2885 was not completed and posted at on the bulletin board.
Childrens product certification was last reviewed on 3/5/2021.
The Consumer Product Safety Commission form was not available for review at inspection.    This was corrected at inspection when the director downloaded, signed, and posted the form.
